definition: to celebrate your birthday with a party
exampleSentence: I'm having a birthday party on Sunday.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật tôi tổ chức tiệc sinh nhật.

definition: to do something special on the day you were born
exampleSentence: We celebrate her birthday every year.
exampleTranslation: Năm nào chúng tôi cũng mừng sinh nhật cô ấy.

definition: to blow on the candles of a cake to put them out
exampleSentence: She blew out the candles on the cake.
exampleTranslation: Cô bé thổi nến trên chiếc bánh.

definition: to cut a cake into pieces
exampleSentence: Who is going to cut the cake?
exampleTranslation: Ai sẽ cắt bánh đây?

definition: to take the paper off gifts
exampleSentence: The kids open presents on Christmas morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng Giáng sinh bọn trẻ mở quà.

definition: to cover a gift with paper
exampleSentence: I wrapped the present in red paper.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gói món quà bằng giấy đỏ.

definition: to post a card to someone for a special day
exampleSentence: I send a card to my grandmother at New Year.
exampleTranslation: Dịp Tết tôi gửi thiệp cho bà.

definition: to attend a wedding
exampleSentence: We are going to a wedding on Saturday.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Bảy chúng tôi đi dự đám cưới.

definition: to speak to a group of people on a special occasion
exampleSentence: The groom made a speech.
exampleTranslation: Chú rể phát biểu.

definition: to put pretty things in the house for a special day
exampleSentence: We decorate the house before Tet.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi trang trí nhà cửa trước Tết.

definition: to hang pretty things in a room
exampleSentence: We put up decorations for the party.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi treo đồ trang trí cho bữa tiệc.

definition: to set up a tree with lights at Christmas
exampleSentence: We put up a Christmas tree in December.
exampleTranslation: Tháng Mười Hai chúng tôi dựng cây thông Noel.

definition: to look at fireworks in the sky
exampleSentence: We watched fireworks on New Year's Eve.
exampleTranslation: Đêm giao thừa chúng tôi xem pháo hoa.

definition: to give gifts to each other
exampleSentence: We exchange gifts at Christmas.
exampleTranslation: Dịp Giáng sinh chúng tôi trao đổi quà cho nhau.

definition: to give money in a red envelope for good luck at New Year
exampleSentence: My grandparents give lucky money to the children.
exampleTranslation: Ông bà lì xì cho các cháu.

definition: to go to see members of your family
exampleSentence: We visit relatives at New Year.
exampleTranslation: Dịp Tết chúng tôi đi thăm họ hàng.

definition: to do something special at the start of the year
exampleSentence: We celebrate New Year with our family.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đón năm mới cùng gia đình.

definition: to decide to do something better in the new year
exampleSentence: I made a resolution to exercise more.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đặt quyết tâm sẽ tập thể dục nhiều hơn.

definition: to count numbers backwards to a special moment
exampleSentence: We counted down to midnight.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đếm ngược đến nửa đêm.

definition: to make a candle burn
exampleSentence: She lit a candle for her grandfather.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thắp một ngọn nến cho ông.

definition: to speak words to God or a spirit
exampleSentence: We said a prayer before the meal.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi cầu nguyện trước bữa ăn.
